title: Economic D-Day more bark than bite, but Hormuz risks rise with Iran's blacklist
section_path: Economic D-Day more bark than bite, but Hormuz risks rise with Iran's blacklist
section_path_text: Economic D-Day more bark than bite, but Hormuz risks rise with Iran's blacklist
summary:
Main
By Mary Melton
Washington's Operation Economic Outcast against Iran appears to be little more than a step up in rhetoric for now. More significant for tankers is the growing stalemate in the Strait of Hormuz. The US is hoping economic pressure will force open the Strait, but Iran has a high pain tolerance.
